---
title: "n8n Workflows"
---

We offer seamless integration with n8n for building no-code and low-code workflow automations powered by AI agents. Connect TruGen.ai agents to your workflows to automate conversations, trigger actions, process webhook events, and sync data across your tools effortlessly.

With the TruGen.ai n8n integration, you can:

* **Create and deploy AI agents** directly from your workflows
* **Trigger automations from webhook events** generated by agent conversations
* **Capture leads and qualification data** from inbound interactions
* **Sync notes, contacts, and conversation outcomes** with CRMs like HubSpot or Salesforce
* **Connect with 1000+ apps and services** through n8n’s workflow ecosystem
* **Build end-to-end automations** for sales, support, recruiting, onboarding, and more

See the TruGen.ai n8n integration documentation for setup instructions, available nodes, and workflow examples.
